title: Advanced English: Core
description: High-value advanced words that appear across many respected vocabulary lists.

lessons.title: Word Set 1–10
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “an entreaty addressed to someone of superior status”?
challenges.explanation: “solicitation” means an entreaty addressed to someone of superior status. Example: “A solicitation to the king for relief.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “something that causes an important event to happen”?
challenges.explanation: “catalyst” means something that causes an important event to happen. Example: “The invasion acted as a catalyst to unite the country.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “inequality or difference in some respect”?
challenges.explanation: “disparity” means inequality or difference in some respect.

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “`I always lie' is a _____ because if it is true it must be false.”
challenges.explanation: “paradox” means (logic) a statement that contradicts itself. Example: “`I always lie' is a paradox because if it is true it must be false.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “Brass is an _____ of zinc and copper.”
challenges.explanation: “alloy” means a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten. Example: “Brass is an alloy of zinc and copper.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “likely to change suddenly or become dangerous”?
challenges.explanation: “volatile” means likely to change suddenly or become dangerous. Example: “A volatile situation with troops and rioters eager for a confrontation.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “strive to equal or match, especially by imitating”?
challenges.explanation: “emulate” means strive to equal or match, especially by imitating. Example: “This artist's drawings cannot emulate his water colors.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “growth by the rapid multiplication of parts”?
challenges.explanation: “proliferation” means growth by the rapid multiplication of parts. Example: “The proliferation of nuclear weapons.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “Concern about the safety and _____ of the vaccine.”
challenges.explanation: “efficacy” means capacity or power to produce a desired effect. Example: “Concern about the safety and efficacy of the vaccine.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “the spreading of information or ideas to many people.”
challenges.explanation: “dissemination” means the spreading of information or ideas to many people.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “augmented” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “solicitation”, “catalyst”, “disparity”.

challenges.question: Put the words of this definition of “alloy” back in the correct order.
Match each advanced word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “solicitation” means an entreaty addressed to someone of superior status. “catalyst” means something that causes an important event to happen. “disparity” means inequality or difference in some respect. “paradox” means (logic) a statement that contradicts itself.

lessons.title: Word Set 11–20
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “added to or made greater in amount or number or strength”?
challenges.explanation: “augmented” means added to or made greater in amount or number or strength. Example: “A greatly augmented collection of books.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “lacking wit or imagination”?
challenges.explanation: “pedestrian” means lacking wit or imagination. Example: “A pedestrian movie plot.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “strict economy and reduced spending, often during difficult times”?
challenges.explanation: “austerity” means strict economy and reduced spending, often during difficult times.

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “He framed the problem within the psychoanalytic _____.”
challenges.explanation: “paradigm” means a typical example, model, or way of understanding something. Example: “He framed the problem within the psychoanalytic paradigm.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “Famed for his _____ spelling.”
challenges.explanation: “eccentric” means a person with an unusual or odd personality. Example: “Famed for his eccentric spelling.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof”?
challenges.explanation: “refute” means overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “solemnly dedicated to or set apart for a high or sacred purpose”?
challenges.explanation: “consecrated” means solemnly dedicated to or set apart for a high or sacred purpose. Example: “A life consecrated to science.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a person or thing that comes before and signals another”?
challenges.explanation: “precursor” means a person or thing that comes before and signals another.

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “A matter-of-fact (or _____) approach to the problem.”
challenges.explanation: “pragmatic” means focused on practical results rather than theory. Example: “A matter-of-fact (or pragmatic) approach to the problem.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “Could you please _____ this letter for me?”
challenges.explanation: “duplicate” means identically copied from an original. Example: “Could you please duplicate this letter for me?”

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “pertinent” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “augmented”, “pedestrian”, “austerity”.

challenges.question: Put the words of this definition of “consecrated” back in the correct order.
Match each advanced word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “augmented” means added to or made greater in amount or number or strength. “pedestrian” means lacking wit or imagination. “austerity” means strict economy and reduced spending, often during difficult times. “paradigm” means a typical example, model, or way of understanding something.

lessons.title: Word Set 21–30
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand”?
challenges.explanation: “pertinent” means having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand. Example: “A list of articles pertinent to the discussion.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “impressive by reason of age”?
challenges.explanation: “venerable” means impressive by reason of age. Example: “A venerable sage with white hair and beard.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a close connection marked by community of interests or similarity in nature or character”?
challenges.explanation: “affinity” means a close connection marked by community of interests or similarity in nature or character. Example: “In anatomical structure prehistoric man shows close affinity with modern humans.”

challenges.question: Fill in the blank: “_____” means “any of a class of organic compounds that have two hydrocarbon groups linked by an oxygen atom.”
challenges.explanation: “ether” means any of a class of organic compounds that have two hydrocarbon groups linked by an oxygen atom.

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “the process of combining two or more things into one.”
challenges.explanation: “amalgamation” means the process of combining two or more things into one.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “preoccupied with the pursuit of pleasure and especially games of chance”?
challenges.explanation: “dissipated” means preoccupied with the pursuit of pleasure and especially games of chance. Example: “Deplorably dissipated and degraded.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “make impossible, especially beforehand”?
challenges.explanation: “preclude” means make impossible, especially beforehand.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “without any attempt at concealment”?
challenges.explanation: “blatant” means without any attempt at concealment. Example: “Blatant disregard of the law.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “_____ years after her artistic peak.”
challenges.explanation: “futile” means producing no result or effect. Example: “Futile years after her artistic peak.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “_____ politicians.”
challenges.explanation: “maverick” means someone who exhibits great independence in thought and action. Example: “Maverick politicians.”

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “endemic” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “pertinent”, “venerable”, “affinity”.

challenges.question: Put the words of this definition of “ether” back in the correct order.
Match each advanced word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “pertinent” means having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand. “venerable” means impressive by reason of age. “affinity” means a close connection marked by community of interests or similarity in nature or character. “ether” means any of a class of organic compounds that have two hydrocarbon groups linked by an oxygen atom.

lessons.title: Word Set 31–40
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a disease that is constantly present to a greater or lesser degree in people of a certain class or in people living in a particular location”?
challenges.explanation: “endemic” means a disease that is constantly present to a greater or lesser degree in people of a certain class or in people living in a particular location. Example: “Food shortages and starvation are endemic in certain parts of the world.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “expressing much in few words”?
challenges.explanation: “concise” means expressing much in few words. Example: “A concise explanation.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances”?
challenges.explanation: “sporadic” means recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances. Example: “A city subjected to sporadic bombing raids.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “_____ morale.”
challenges.explanation: “bolster” means to support, strengthen, or improve something. Example: “Bolster morale.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “He faced a _____ of details.”
challenges.explanation: “myriad” means a large indefinite number. Example: “He faced a myriad of details.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “not dangerous to health”?
challenges.explanation: “benign” means not dangerous to health. Example: “The benign influence of pure air.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “greatly desired”?
challenges.explanation: “coveted” means greatly desired.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “marked by precise accordance with details”?
challenges.explanation: “meticulous” means marked by precise accordance with details. Example: “Almost worryingly meticulous in his business formalities.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “The _____ life of an undersea diver.”
challenges.explanation: “precarious” means affording no ease or reassurance. Example: “The precarious life of an undersea diver.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “deviation from the normal or common order or form or rule.”
challenges.explanation: “anomaly” means deviation from the normal or common order or form or rule.

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “fallacy” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “endemic”, “concise”, “sporadic”.

challenges.question: Put the words of this definition of “endemic” back in the correct order.
Match each advanced word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “endemic” means a disease that is constantly present to a greater or lesser degree in people of a certain class or in people living in a particular location. “concise” means expressing much in few words. “sporadic” means recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances. “bolster” means to support, strengthen, or improve something.

lessons.title: Word Set 41–50
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a misconception resulting from incorrect reasoning”?
challenges.explanation: “fallacy” means a misconception resulting from incorrect reasoning.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “an unusually gifted or intelligent (young) person”?
challenges.explanation: “prodigy” means an unusually gifted or intelligent (young) person. Example: “She is a chess prodigy.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “fearful expectation or anticipation”?
challenges.explanation: “apprehension” means fearful expectation or anticipation. Example: “The student looked around the examination room with apprehension.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “_____ a solution.”
challenges.explanation: “elicit” means derive by reason. Example: “Elicit a solution.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “The officer's _____ behavior increased the victim's uneasiness.”
challenges.explanation: “equivocal” means open to two or more interpretations. Example: “The officer's equivocal behavior increased the victim's uneasiness.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “the property of being ingenious”?
challenges.explanation: “ingenuity” means the property of being ingenious. Example: “A plot of great ingenuity.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “one who stays for only a short time”?
challenges.explanation: “transient” means one who stays for only a short time. Example: “Youth's transient beauty.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “an unsophisticated country person”?
challenges.explanation: “rustic” means an unsophisticated country person. Example: “Rustic awkwardness.”

challenges.question: Fill in the blank: “_____” means “discouraging through fear.”
challenges.explanation: “daunting” means discouraging through fear.

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “Her feelings of affection are _____ but easily awakened.”
challenges.explanation: “dormant” means in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation. Example: “Her feelings of affection are dormant but easily awakened.”

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “mundane” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “fallacy”, “prodigy”, “apprehension”.

challenges.question: Put the words of this definition of “dormant” back in the correct order.
Match each advanced word to its definition.
challenges.explanation: “fallacy” means a misconception resulting from incorrect reasoning. “prodigy” means an unusually gifted or intelligent (young) person. “apprehension” means fearful expectation or anticipation. “elicit” means derive by reason.

lessons.title: Word Set 51–60
lessons.description: Learn ten ranked advanced words through definitions, sentence completion, grammar, ordering, and matching review.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “ordinary, routine, and lacking excitement”?
challenges.explanation: “mundane” means ordinary, routine, and lacking excitement. Example: “Yet a mundane wonder of unimagined kind.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “contented to a fault with oneself or one's actions”?
challenges.explanation: “complacent” means contented to a fault with oneself or one's actions. Example: “He had become complacent after years of success.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a reduction in amount, degree, or intensity”?
challenges.explanation: “abatement” means a reduction in amount, degree, or intensity. Example: “Laws enforcing noise abatement.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “_____ intelligence operations.”
challenges.explanation: “clandestine” means conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods. Example: “Clandestine intelligence operations.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “represented accurately or precisely.”
challenges.explanation: “delineated” means represented accurately or precisely.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “firm and dependable especially in loyalty”?
challenges.explanation: “steadfast” means firm and dependable especially in loyalty. Example: “Steadfast resolve.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “having a clear mind”?
challenges.explanation: “lucid” means having a clear mind. Example: “A lucid moment in his madness.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “formally made public”?
challenges.explanation: “promulgated” means formally made public.

challenges.question: Fill in the blank: “_____” means “to feel deep respect and admiration for someone or something.”
challenges.explanation: “revere” means to feel deep respect and admiration for someone or something.

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “They were protected until the _____ of the fort.”
challenges.explanation: “capitulation” means the act of surrendering or accepting an opponent's terms. Example: “They were protected until the capitulation of the fort.”

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “oblique” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “mundane”, “complacent”, “abatement”.

Match each advanced word to its definition.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “indirect, slanting, or not expressed straightforwardly”?
challenges.explanation: “oblique” means indirect, slanting, or not expressed straightforwardly. Example: “The axis of an oblique cone is not perpendicular to its base.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy”?
challenges.explanation: “opaque” means not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy. Example: “Opaque windows of the jail.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits”?
challenges.explanation: “contentious” means inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits. Example: “A central and contentious element of the book- Tim W.Ferfuson.”

challenges.question: Fill in the blank: “_____” means “selecting what seems best of various styles or ideas.”
challenges.explanation: “eclectic” means selecting what seems best of various styles or ideas.

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “an inference about the future (or about some hypothetical situation) based on known facts and observations.”
challenges.explanation: “extrapolation” means an inference about the future (or about some hypothetical situation) based on known facts and observations.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “an absence of emotion or enthusiasm”?
challenges.explanation: “apathy” means an absence of emotion or enthusiasm.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “completely free from dirt or contamination”?
challenges.explanation: “pristine” means completely free from dirt or contamination. Example: “Handed her his pristine white handkerchief.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “potentially existing but not presently evident or realized”?
challenges.explanation: “latent” means potentially existing but not presently evident or realized. Example: “A latent fingerprint.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “He brought _____ upon his family.”
challenges.explanation: “reproach” means express criticism towards. Example: “He brought reproach upon his family.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “A _____ performance.”
challenges.explanation: “consummate” means having or revealing supreme mastery or skill. Example: “A consummate performance.”

challenges.question: Which word does not belong with the others in this word set?
challenges.explanation: “abdication” belongs to a different word set; the rest of this set is “oblique”, “opaque”, “contentious”.

Match each advanced word to its definition.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “the trait of abstaining (especially from alcohol)”?

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “lack of agreement or harmony”?

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a feeling of ill will arousing active hostility”?

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “harsh criticism or disapproval”?
challenges.explanation: “censure” means harsh criticism or disapproval.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “of an obscure nature”?
challenges.explanation: “cryptic” means of an obscure nature. Example: “The new insurance policy is written without cryptic or mysterious terms.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “confined to and understandable by only an enlightened inner circle”?

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “To say they have priority is not to say they have complete _____.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “a pause from doing something (as work).”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “hostile, aggressive, and ready to fight”?

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “weakening in force or intensity”?

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “secret agreement”?

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “Utah and the _____ state of Idaho.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “An _____ tenant always reads the small print in a lease.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors”?
challenges.explanation: “antagonism” means the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors. Example: “The inherent antagonism of capitalism and socialism.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion”?
challenges.explanation: “arduous” means characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion. Example: “Your willingness after these six arduous days to remain here- F.D.Roosevelt.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “auguring favorable circumstances and good luck”?
challenges.explanation: “auspicious” means auguring favorable circumstances and good luck. Example: “An auspicious beginning for the campaign.”

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “I _____ you from this responsibility.”
challenges.explanation: “absolve” means to free someone from blame, guilt, or responsibility. Example: “I absolve you from this responsibility.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly completes this sentence: “The _____ between eastern and western culture.”
challenges.explanation: “dichotomy” means a division into two sharply contrasting parts. Example: “The dichotomy between eastern and western culture.”

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “tendency to believe readily”?
challenges.explanation: “credulity” means tendency to believe readily.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “a compact breed of harness horse”?
challenges.explanation: “hackney” means a compact breed of harness horse.

challenges.question: Which advanced word means “the highest or most successful point”?
challenges.explanation: “zenith” means the highest or most successful point.

challenges.question: Complete the sentence: “_____ writings.”
challenges.explanation: “dogmatic” means characterized by assertion of unproved or unprovable principles. Example: “Dogmatic writings.”

challenges.question: Choose the word that correctly fits: “_____” means “disagreeable sounds.”
